main_body: stone tower with a conical green tiled roof
top_band: green shingled roof slope from row 4 to row 40 (with gold finial at rows 0-3)
evidence: The structure has a large visible roof slope (rows 4-40) above a vertical stone wall face (rows 41-95). Row 41 forms a dark brown eave/beam under the roof overhang, and rows 42-43 cast an eave shadow onto the upper stone blocks. The window (rows 51-59) and door (rows 70-91) are recessed with inner shadows.

style.evidence: While the roof has a decent 6-step green ramp, the stonework on the wall consists of large, uniform, repetitive rectangular blocks filled with flat grey tones (e.g., 6x3 flat fills per brick) lacking internal grain or per-stone irregular shading compared to the richly textured cobblestone and plaster of the Beodeul references. The door and window also use clean geometric flat fills.
